twokeys.answer: Both of you carry one changed copy of the CYP21A2 gene. Carriers are healthy and do not have the condition. Each of your pregnancies has a 1 in 4 chance of an affected child, a 2 in 4 chance of a carrier child, and a 1 in 4 chance of a child with neither changed copy. Being related does not change these chances for this gene but adds risk for other conditions.
